label: SafetyComplianceWorkforce process: Execute customer safety programs and regulatory reporting — Launch safety campaigns and prepare regulatory documentation communicating hazard controls and compliance status to customers and authorities.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 ✓ BEST for safety material ordering
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1

WORKFORCE SAFETY & COMPENSATION:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1

ENGINEERING & CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 ✓ BEST for material substitution via compliance
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1

CUSTOMER SAFETY PROGRAMS & REGULATORY REPORTING:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1 ✓ BEST for SafetyComplianceWorkforce
- Automates safety compliance campaigns across customer segments and accounts
- Coordinates regulatory compliance initiatives
- Processes compliance status updates  
- Manages escalation workflows for safety gaps
- Orchestrates targeted interventions based on risk profiles
- Entities: Campaign, CustomerAccount, CustomerSegment

EHS ADDITIONAL AGENTS:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1 (engineering/BOM validation)
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1 (vendor verification)

ORDER-TO-PRODUCTION:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
